lines.zh: 鹿角挂着彩灯，走一步晃一下
lines.en: Fairy lights on my antlers sway with every step.
My hooves are hard and click on the floor.
I circle the diner.

lines.zh: 身上的绒毛磨秃了一块
lines.en: A patch of my fuzz has worn bald.

lines.zh: 布套里的关节卡一卡，再走
lines.en: A joint sticks, then I walk on.
I'm not chasing anyone; I'm only walking.
In winter they put me by the door.
The string of lights flickers.
I pass the counter, and it's dusty.

lines.zh: 我的影子在墙上，角很大
lines.en: My shadow on the wall has huge antlers.
Turning is slow; my antlers knock things.
I walk toward the light.
I lift my head as if listening.
There's an iron frame under the fuzz.

lines.zh: 我不动的时候，铃铛也不响
lines.en: When I'm still, the bells don't ring.

lines.zh: 窗户外面在下雪就好了
lines.en: It would be nice if it were snowing outside.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子是红的，一直亮
lines.en: My nose is red and always lit.
This face is a stitched smile.
I'm waiting for some music.
There's a rat behind the counter.
My string lights have come loose.
Don't touch my antlers; the paint comes off.
You look at me, and I look back.
I'm not the meanest thing in this place.
Keep your hand away from my antlers.

lines.zh: 这张脸本来是给小孩看的
lines.en: This face was made for children.

lines.zh: 你的脚步让我想起客人
lines.en: Your steps remind me of customers.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，不代表我不能动
lines.en: Standing still doesn't mean I can't move.

lines.zh: 我的玻璃眼映出你的灯。
lines.en: My glass eyes reflect your lantern.

lines.zh: 这里圣诞节从来没来过
lines.en: Christmas never came here.
I'm looking at what's in your hand.
Back away and I'll stop looking.
A patch of the suit tore.
The iron inside clanged once.
I don't cry out.
The lights flickered once.
My antlers went crooked.
That put me one step back.
Fuzz came off.
I straighten, and lean back.
I can bear this much.
Don't hit a second time.
I don't eat; I'm an animatronic.

lines.zh: 那东西挂在我的角上会好看
lines.en: That would look nice on my antlers.
You wave it; I don't move.
I belong in a display window.
The smell of candy; I don't need it.
Leave it on the counter.

lines.zh: 这点东西不够换我走过来
lines.en: That won't make me walk over.

lines.zh: 你把灯串给我，我倒想要
lines.en: Give me a string of lights and I'd take it.
I'm not hungry, only worn.
Put it down and go.
You bumped me and the lights jingled.
My antlers caught you.
Don't press on me; the fuzz is dusty.
I don't push; I just stand.
You stepped back and I turned.
That knocked my head crooked.
My hoof found your foot.

lines.zh: 你挤过去的时候碰了我的角
lines.en: You caught my antlers squeezing past.
Too narrow here; we collided.
Give me room; I can't turn.
I'm an animatronic.

lines.zh: 架子上还有一只，落了灰
lines.en: There's another on the shelf, dust-covered.
We're displayed together like a pair.
That isn't in the program.

lines.zh: 我的线路里没有这一项。
lines.en: That isn't wired into me.
It's older than me and its lights are dead.
I need no partner, only light.
Don't arrange things for us.

lines.zh: 台上那两只也是成对的
lines.en: Those two on the stage are paired too.
That's a strange question.

lines.zh: 我的手是硬的，捡不起来
lines.en: My hands are stiff; I can't pick it up.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的，都是客人的
lines.en: What's on the floor belongs to customers.
I nudge it with a hoof.

lines.zh: 这个亮亮的，可以挂角上
lines.en: This shiny one could go on my antlers.
I pinch it and it slips.

lines.zh: 地上这枚硬币，值不了什么
lines.en: This coin on the floor is worth little.
Bending is hard; my neck sticks.
Something rattles under my hoof.
I tuck it into the suit; there's room.
Don't leave fallen things here.
You hit me.
That one, I remember.
I don't start, but I answer.
The whole string lit up.
My head turned toward you.
If you're running, start now.
It's just the two of us here.
The lights on my antlers stopped flickering.
You've backed to the counter.

lines.zh: 我的鹿角灯一盏盏亮起。
lines.en: The lights on my antlers come on one by one.
Now it's my turn.

lines.zh: 这一晚，本来是不用流血的
lines.en: Tonight didn't need blood.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛里没有别的意思
lines.en: There's nothing else in my eyes.
Stand still and I'll stand still.
Hit me again and you'll regret it.
I'm locked on.

lines.zh: 你打一下就跑，这不公平
lines.en: You hit and run; that's unfair.
I'm slow, but my direction doesn't change.
You're circling the counter.
The lights on my antlers find you.
At this distance I can reach.
You stepped on broken glass.

lines.zh: 我不急，这间店只有一个门
lines.en: No rush; the diner has only one door.
You pushed a table to block me.
A table won't stop iron.

lines.zh: 你躲在柜子后面，呼吸太重
lines.en: You're behind the cabinet, breathing too loud.
I lower my head to charge.
I've memorized your place.
No light at the end of the corridor.
The suit is creaking; it's about to move.
Three blocks more.
You stop, and I stop.

lines.zh: 这不是游戏，别以为有规则
lines.en: This isn't a game; don't expect rules.
One turn and I'd touch you.
Right here.
The antlers ram home, hard.
A hoof drives into your chest.
I'm not quick, but the hit is solid.

lines.zh: 灯串在打的过程里灭了
lines.en: The lights went out mid-swing.
You're knocked into the wall.

lines.zh: 布套里的铁比你想象的重
lines.en: The iron in the suit is heavier than you think.
I hit once and pull back.
That landed on the shoulder.

lines.zh: 你挡住了一只角，另一只没挡住
lines.en: You stopped one antler, not the other.

lines.zh: 店里的东西被我撞翻了
lines.en: I knocked things over in the diner.

lines.zh: 我的动作很笨，但我有力气
lines.en: My moves are clumsy, but I have weight.
You back two steps, bleeding.
Something's stuck on my antlers.
That one wasn't meant to kill.

lines.zh: 我停下来，看你还能不能站
lines.en: I stop and see if you can still stand.

lines.zh: 再打一下，我就不会停了
lines.en: One more and I won't stop.
All my lights went out.
I shove you onto the counter.
You're shouting; it's very shrill.

lines.zh: 这一间屋子，只有一个人能站着出去
lines.en: Only one of us walks out of this room.
The display window lights came on first.
I was set back in my old spot.
The dust was beaten off my suit.
The lights on my antlers got power.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋打开，我站在通道上
lines.en: The egg opened; I stood in the aisle.
Today isn't a holiday.

lines.zh: 有人把我调成活动状态
lines.en: Someone set me to active.
I step down from the display shelf.

lines.zh: 这间店的装饰，只有我一个能走
lines.en: Of all the decor here, only I can walk.
I lift my head and look at the ceiling.
I pace about, waiting for you.
The door sounded, and I woke.

lines.zh: 火烤着布套，里面的铁还热
lines.en: Flame bakes the suit; the iron inside is still warm.
I fell, antlers striking first.
Water fills the suit and I sink.
One antler was blown off.
The arrow lodged in the fuzz.

lines.zh: 法术打过来，我的灯更亮了
lines.en: The spell hit and my lights got brighter.
I don't eat; I only wear out.
Lightning hit my antlers and every light blazed.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有地板，我还在走
lines.en: No floor in the void, and I still walk.
